rules.title: City of San Diego Tenant Protection Ordinance
rules.requirement: Tenant buyout agreements must be in writing, handed to the tenant at signing, and carry bold 14-point statements of tenant rights, with translations where needed. Buyouts below the relocation assistance owed, or that waive ordinance rights, are void. Tenants may sue, and may raise violations as a defense in unlawful detainer.
rules.key_value: Wrongful eviction damages of at least 3x actual economic damages; failure to pay relocation assistance: at least 3x the required relocation assistance plus actual damages
rules.penalty: Injunctive and equitable relief, money damages including punitive damages, at least 3x actual economic damages for wrongful recovery of possession, at least 3x unpaid relocation assistance plus actual damages, and attorney's fees in civil actions other than unlawful detainer.
rules.citation: Chapter 9, Article 8, Division 7 of the San Diego Municipal Code
rules.status_basis: Page refers to the ordinance's 'effective period' beginning June 24, 2023 and to remedies under § 98.0706(c); effective date inferred from that reference.
rules.quoted_span: Buyout agreements for amounts less than the amount of relocation assistance available to Tenant is void. Buyout agreements which attempt to waive or limit a Tenant’s rights under this Ordinance are contrary to public policy and void.
